name: var_dump simple object
code: <?php class P { public $a = 1; public $b = "x"; } var_dump(new P());

name: var_dump visibility annotations
code: <?php class V { public $pub = 1; protected $pro = 2; private $pri = 3; } var_dump(new V());

name: var_dump inherited properties order and private owner
code: <?php class A { public $a = 1; private $secret = "a"; protected $shared = "s"; } class B extends A { public $b = 2; private $own = "b"; } var_dump(new B());
expected:
object(B)#1 (5) {
  ["a"]=>
  int(1)
  ["secret":"A":private]=>
  string(1) "a"
  ["shared":protected]=>
  string(1) "s"
  ["b"]=>
  int(2)
  ["own":"B":private]=>
  string(1) "b"
}

name: var_dump object ids in creation order
code: <?php class N {} $x = new N(); $y = new N(); $z = new N(); var_dump($z, $x, $y);

name: var_dump stdClass and dynamic properties
code: <?php $o = new stdClass(); $o->name = "n"; $o->list = [1, 2]; var_dump($o);

name: var_dump nested objects and arrays
code: <?php class Box { public $item; public $tags = []; } $inner = new Box(); $inner->item = 5; $outer = new Box(); $outer->item = $inner; $outer->tags = ["a" => $inner, 0 => 1.5]; var_dump($outer);

code: <?php class T { public $v = 1; } $t = new T(); var_dump([$t, $t]);
